title: 1855. Maximum Distance Between a Pair of Values

examples.explanation: The valid pairs are (0,0), (2,2), (2,3), (2,4), (3,3), (3,4), and (4,4). The maximum distance is 2 with pair (2,4).
The valid pairs are (0,0), (0,1), and (1,1). The maximum distance is 1 with pair (0,1).
The valid pairs are (2,2), (2,3), (2,4), (3,3), and (3,4). The maximum distance is 2 with pair (2,4).
